ModMetaData.name: Seasons & Holidays – 12 Months, Real Holidays & Weather
ModMetaData.author: Bolek98
ModMetaData.description:
The RimWorld year as 12 real months, with real holidays, weather by month and a calendar.
- 12 months of 5 days (Aprimay = March–May …), the date shows "December 4". Play from the game year 5500, from year 0 or year 1. - 15 holidays, Czech and international: New Year, Valentine's Day, Carnival, Easter, Witches' Night, May Day, Children's Day, Midsummer, Harvest Festival, Halloween, All Souls' Day, Thanksgiving, St. Nicholas, Christmas, New Year's Eve – moods, parties, gifts, fireworks, a white Christmas. - Traditions: a holiday celebrated again next year gives more mood. - Birthdays, first snow, spring and summer moods, winter blues. - Weather by month and three new weathers: hoarfrost, Indian summer, spring showers. - Calendar tab: the whole year, temperatures, growing season, holidays and birthdays. - Optional: holidays by the real date of your computer.
Safe to add to an existing save. Requires Harmony. English and Czech.
